_comment: The owner's server decisions, by decision id (docs/decisions, srv-*). Apply with build_play_server.py --rules THIS_FILE ... --force. Every value here is the audit's recommendation (docs/design/server-readiness.md, sections 4 and 6), not a decision: change it to what the owner said. Keys starting with _ are ignored. The file is remembered in the server's play-options.json, so later rebuilds keep applying it.
_srv-pvp: "as-is": the pack as it is (no team, pvp and GraviGun.cfg untouched; the owner's 2026-10-25 decision). "team": everyone on one vanilla team with friendly fire off, Gravity Gun cannot grab players, server pvp stays on for duels by leaving the team. "off": pvp=false. "on": vanilla, written out (pvp=true, Gravity Gun grabs players).
_srv-quests: "personal": BetterQuesting parties off, each friend progresses alone. "parties": parties allowed (BQ default). Takes effect at world creation; an existing world needs /bq_admin default load.
_srv-sleep: Percent of online players who must be in bed to skip the night (Morpheus, server-only). 0 = no sleep vote mod, vanilla rule (everyone must sleep).
_srv-afk: Minutes idle before a player is kicked (player-idle-timeout). 0 = never.
_srv-hub: spawn-protection radius in blocks: non-ops cannot place or break inside it (vanilla interactions only). 0 = off.
_srv-loaders: world_anchors: "off" (Railcraft World Anchor not craftable; personal and passive anchors stay), "capped" (craftable, but Forge allows Railcraft 20 tickets x 9 chunks per world), "on" (unlimited). sync_shells: whether Sync shell storages keep their chunk loaded. op_loaders_offline: whether an operator's ChickenChunks loaders keep running while the operator is offline (players' never do).
_srv-graves: Text for the rules post only: "shared" (anyone may loot a grave; ask first) or "owner-only" (a rule, not enforced: GraveStones has no owner-only option).
_srv-tools: chest_transporter_spawners: may Chest Transporters pick up mob spawners. projecte_time_watch_pedestal: extra ticks the Watch of Flowing Time gives nearby machines from a pedestal (mod default 18; 0 = none). lycanites_first_event_day: first overworld day a random Lycanites mob event may start (mod default 0).
